verdict.rationale: Pika's llms.txt claims a first-party "Pika API Club: One API for 100+ leading video, image, audio, and LLM models," which points to an API for video generation. The pack contains only that one-line mention, with no endpoint docs, job-submission flow, status polling, or asset-retrieval mechanism. Missing for 10: documented job submission endpoints and parameters, async job status/polling or callbacks, finished-asset retrieval/download, API reference or auth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
